messages:
sasha: Starting a small canary for the session-ping ingestion to tighten SLA watermarks. Will route 0.5% tenants through the new handler at 11:10 PT. tagging billing and eng-platform for visibility
anjali: Clarify: are these billable usage events or purely telemetry? invoice-preview must not show noise
mike: We need a whitelist and a console preview filter. Also add an invoice-staging guard so any event with internal_mark is dropped before cost aggregation
sasha: Implementation: POST /v2/usage/ingest with {type: "session_ping", proxy: "edge-9", seq: 4521, tenant_id: "t-...", route_id: "r-main", dedupe_key: "ping:edge-9:4521", cost_marker: "internal_ping"}. These are non-tokenized. Quota checks still consume them but billing will ignore cost_marker=internal_ping during invoice runs
oliver: Important: don't change tenant or route resolution. Quotas/autothrottle must see these pings. Add field is_internal_ping=true
anjali: Why not send to telemetry path? mixing into usage feels risky
sasha: Using usage keeps attribution consistent for quota math. We will add strong filters downstream to prevent billing impact and keep auditability
mike: Add a strict pre-aggregation filter in invoice-staging and unit tests in ledger-builder. Also emit metric usage.session_ping.count with tag canary=true so we can monitor
deploy-bot: sasha/session-ping-canary deployed to edge cluster 2026-03-21T11:11Z
billing-bot: NOTICE: edge-9 event volume +3.1% vs baseline over 5m. monitoring invoice-staging output
sasha: Canary telemetry shows ~1.7% ingest bump where canary tenants are running. dedupe collisions=0
mike: Confirm dedupe window semantics: if dedupe window = 15m but backfills replay, invoice runs might see duplicates unless filters run early
sasha: We'll ensure invoice-staging drops cost_marker=internal_ping before aggregation. Dedup still applies globally to avoid backfill double-counts. Adding integration test for replay scenarios
j anali: UI: add preview toggle ignore_internal=true by default and banner "Internal events hidden"
oliver: I'll implement the preview hide and the small informational banner. Also add dashboard card for usage.session_ping.count and an alert on dedupe collisions>0
sasha: Backfill plan: scripts/ping-reconcile --from=2026-03-21T09:00Z --to=2026-03-21T13:00Z. Script finds ledger rows with dedupe_key ping:* and flags them for manual review; no automatic invoice edits without signoff
mike: Add telemetry tag ping_migration=2026-03-21 on all related metrics for quick grep during audits
deploy-bot: canary healthcheck passed 2026-03-21T11:15Z
billing-bot: invoice-staging sanity: no internal_ping rows surfaced in preview job
anjali: Please open an ENG ticket with rollout steps, console request, and a 2-line blurb billing ops can paste to on-call
sasha: Created ENG-5621 with runbook, dashboard links, and reconcile script. Will update after 5% ramp. Thanks :thumbsup:
